constraints: Fix only defects confirmed by 2/2 adversarial verifiers with low fix risk
No breaking changes to tool response shapes
context: Fixed 6 confirmed high-severity defects: assemble ordering, resolved-obligation leak, silent warning drop, why() retired statuses, ingest data loss, reverse-migrate wipe
rationale: a counter still loses the warning text entirely, whereas a 200-char summary costs ~50 tokens and preserves the actionable part; only warnings that cannot fit even as a summary increment warnings_omitted
summary: Chose degrade-to-summary-only for warnings that exceed the token budget, rather than only counting the drops
